title: Occident
summary: OC'CIDENT, noun [Latin occidens, occido, to fall; ob and cade.] The west; the western quarter of the hemisphere; so called from the decline or fall of the sun.

inlines.v: OC'CIDENT, noun [Latin occidens, occido, to fall; ob and cade.] The west; the western quarter of the hemisphere; so called from the decline or fall of the sun.
